name: "icapital.biz Berhad"
recent: iCapital.biz Berhad 近期出现多项股权变动，主要股东 City of London Investment Management Company Limited 于11月26日申报不再是大股东。公司于11月13日宣布派发截至2027年5月31日财年的中期股息，并将在11月28日召开第22届常年股东大会。此外，公司于10月及11月多次公告重大诉讼事项。
notable: 宣布派发截至2027年5月31日财年的中期股息。
City of London Investment Management Company Limited 于11月26日申报不再是大股东。
将于11月28日召开第22届常年股东大会。
risks: 公司于10月22日及11月17日公告重大诉讼事项。
基金管理人员工 Tan Teng Boo 于11月4日、11日及19日通过公开市场增持公司股份。
earnings: 截至2026年5月31日财年，公司营收为4,282,000令吉，净利润为1,194,000令吉，净利率27.9%。营收环比增长79.7%，同比增长44.8%；上一期净利率为-11.6%。

recent_en: iCapital.biz Berhad has seen multiple shareholding changes recently, with substantial shareholder City of London Investment Management Company Limited ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 26 November. It also announced material litigation in October and November.
notable_en: Declared an interim dividend for the financial year ending 31 May 2027.
City of London Investment Management Company Limited ceased to be a substantial shareholder on 26 November.
risks_en: The company announced material litigation on 22 October and 17 November.
Tan Teng Boo, a designated person of the fund manager, acquired shares through the open market on 4, 11 and 19 November.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 31 May 2026, revenue was MYR 4,282,000 and net income was MYR 1,194,000, with a net margin of 27.9%. Revenue grew 79.7% QoQ and 44.8% YoY; the previous period's net margin was -11.6%.
